name: The Crusher
design_intent: SPORTS hazard court (v8_sports_courts.md tier 4, hazard='crusher'). The center_pitch shell (2800x1600, strict mirror about x=1400 -- a known-fair symmetric base) with the two mid-caroms REMOVED and a single HORIZONTAL CRUSHER centred ON the exact centre axis (x=1400) at mid-height (y=750). Two steel heads slam inward from left+right on a telegraphed rhythm and CRUSH-kill any player caught at impact (the EXISTING kill(&ring_out) path; SPORTS respawns at 99 lives, never eliminates), then RETRACT to a wide open gap (the clear beat). Ball-hazard (v8 §3.2): when the ball is in the crush lane as the heads close, the crusher EJECTS it along the OPEN (perpendicular, VERTICAL) axis via Ball.receive_hazard_impulse (~2000px/s, re-capped to 2400) -> the ball squirts UP/DOWN into open play, never trapped (anti-softlock §5) and never punted toward a goal (SYM-4). SYMMETRY (SC-SYM/SYM-3): a single hazard whose crush point is ON the centre axis is inherently mirror-symmetric -> no side bias; the two heads travel identical mirrored distances. SYM-4 (no own-goal machine): the crush point + head sweep stay in the central third (heads span ~x1000..1800 open, ~x1180..1620 closed), >850px clear of each goal mouth (x170..310 / x2490..2630); the swept path never overlaps a goal mouth, and the vertical eject sends the ball into open play, not into a net. ANTI-WALL (§5): the crusher is OVERLAP-ONLY (no solid collision) so it NEVER physically walls off a half -- players+ball pass through; only the slam INSTANT is lethal, and the long open dwell (~2.25s of a 3.5s period) is the clear window to reach the ball or cross. TELEGRAPHY (§2.0#2): a windup shudder + hazard-red danger band over the crush lane for telegraph_lead 0.7s before a fast readable close; guide rails show the travel track. The kickoff ball spawns at centre (1400, ~800) inside the crush lane -> the headline chaos beat. NO powerup_spawners. Spawns verbatim from center_pitch (mirrored ends, clear of the central crusher). FLIGHT GATE (from center_pitch): centre x=1400, nearest inner spawn x700 -> 700px (> 527 spring drift), centre-to-far-goal 1160px -> boost required.
